title: Cassius Dio, Roman History, Books 1–35 (fragments plus Zonaras' epitome 7–9); «Римская история», кн. I–XXXV
author: Cassius Dio (Zonaras for the epitome)
size: Boissevain vol. I fragments plus Zonaras 7–9, est. 70–90k words
edition: Boissevain 1895–1901 (public domain). Zonaras: Dindorf, Teubner 1868–75 (public domain)
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia lists professional Russian only for books 51–80 (Makhlayuk et al. 2011, 2014). Books 36, 37 and 48 exist only as amateur versions from English (ancientrome). Nothing for books 1–35
en_evidence: Loeb, E. Cary (1914–27); online at LacusCurtius
other_translations: French listed on ru.wikipedia. German (O. Veh) not re-verified
value: The main Greek narrative of regal and Republican Rome where Livy is lost: the Punic Wars, the Gracchi. Books 36–50 likewise lack a professional Russian translation, which makes this one of the largest Russian gaps in Roman historiography and useful for broad audiences and teaching.
ai_feasibility: High: Attic-style Greek. The provenance of each excerpt (Constantinian excerpts, Zonaras, Tzetzes) must be marked in the apparatus
pilot_unit: Regal period: Books 1–3 fragments plus Zonaras 7.1–12, est. 8–10k words
